events.title: DemoBlog 02: Steam Next Fest Update (v0.5.0)
events.summary: Hi everyone!On October 19th the Steam Next Fest will begin! This is a huge deal for me, because it’s an event where upcoming demos and games receive more visibility on Steam, so more people will get to play my game!! So the past week I stopped working on features of the full game and gave more attention to my little demo guy.More colors and detailsThe level was feeling kinda flat, so I wanted to add more details and life to it. events.title: Demo Blog 01: Introductions
events.summary: Hi everyone!I decided to start posting here on Steam about my journey creating and publishing Two Ants by “myself” for two reasons. First, so you guys can get to know me a bit better, a real, definitely-not-a-robot guy in the backstage. And second, for myself, to track this like a journal.
